verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no first-party export or offboarding feature. The only route out is the REST API, which exposes conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels and analytics as JSON, plus the MCP server. That would make extraction a DIY job, throttled by documented rate limits (5 concurrent requests, 900 per 15 minutes). Missing for 10: documented bulk/self-serve export, standard archive formats (e.g. MBOX/EML/vCard/CSV), coverage guarantees for all data types (chats, tasks, audit logs, attachments), and any independent confirmation that a full exit is feasible.
